# AO Foundation

> > The AO Foundation is a global medical education organization providing surgical reference materials, training courses, and research resources for trauma, orthopedic, craniomaxillofacial, spine, and veterinary surgery.

The AO Foundation operates through specialized communities (AO Trauma, AO CMF, AO Spine) and maintains the comprehensive AO Surgery Reference database for evidence-based fracture management and surgical techniques. Members access educational content through myAO 2.0, including courses, webinars, classifications (AO/OTA), and the AO PEER platform.

## Key Topics

- AO Surgery Reference
- AO Trauma
- AO CMF (Craniomaxillofacial)
- myAO 2.0
- Orthopedic trauma
- Fracture management
- AO/OTA Classifications
- Surgical education and training

- Medical education courses
- Periprosthetic fractures
- Pediatric trauma
- Spine deformities
- AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)
- Veterinary surgery

## Core Resources

- [AO Foundation: Transforming Surgery–Changing Lives](https://aofoundation.org): AO Foundation homepage for trauma and musculoskeletal surgery education
- [AO Foundation Surgery Reference](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org): AO Surgery Reference for fracture management and clinical guidelines
- [The AO Surgery Reference](https://edit.aofoundation.org/our-services-and-resources/ao-surgery-reference): Overview of AO Surgery Reference resource for fracture treatment planning

## Specialty Communities

- [AO CMF](https://aocmf.aofoundation.org): AO CMF craniomaxillofacial surgery community with myAO 2.0 and courses
- [AO North America](https://aofoundation.org/aona): AO North America regional hub for courses, fellowships, and OneAO event

## Clinical References

- [Pediatric trauma](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/orthopedic-trauma/pediatric-trauma): Pediatric trauma surgical reference edited by Howard and Kremli
- [Periprosthetic fractures](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/orthopedic-trauma/periprosthetic-fractures): Periprosthetic fracture treatment reference edited by Baumgaertner
- [Deformity - AO Foundation Surgery Reference](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/spine/deformities): Spine deformity reference covering scoliosis and kyphosis by Vialle
- [Dog](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/vet/dog): Veterinary surgery reference for canine orthopedics and skeletal conditions

## Support & FAQ

- [Frequently asked questions](https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/further-reading/faq): FAQ for AO Surgery Reference access, content usage, and membership
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://int.aofoundation.org/trauma/faq): AO Trauma FAQ for course registration, webinars, and member support
